name: Big price moves
summary: Every 15 minutes, spot popular markets whose odds moved 5% or more in the last hour.
description:
Prices on Polymarket are odds: a Yes at 0.62 means the market thinks the answer is 62% likely. A sudden move often means news.

This workflow takes the 20 most liquid open markets, compares each one's price now with an hour ago, and keeps the ones that moved by 5% or more. Only new remembers what it already reported, so the same move shows up once, not every 15 minutes.

- Press Run to try it now; a quiet hour may find nothing, which is fine.
- Switch Active on and it checks every 15 minutes by itself. Open Executions to watch the runs, and turn on Show new runs as they finish.
- Want a message when something moves? Add a Webhook node after Only new, or start from Alerts in Discord or Slack.

nodes.notes: Runs every 15 minutes while the workflow is active. Run also starts it once, for a test.

nodes.name: 20 most liquid
nodes.notes: Keeps the 20 markets with the most money in their books, where moves matter most.

nodes.name: Change over 1 hour
nodes.notes: Compares the first outcome's price, usually Yes, with an hour ago. Adds priceThen, priceNow, changePct and absChangePct, the move ignoring its direction.

nodes.name: Moved 5% or more
nodes.notes: Keeps markets whose odds moved by at least 5%, up or down.
Passes each market once an hour at most, so one move is reported once.
